jobs.name: instagram-carousel-daily
jobs.prompt:
Run the Instagram carousel generator and poster cron job.
This will:
1. Select a content template (or fetch from RSS/JSON/API)
2. Generate carousel slides using thread-to-carousel.py
3. Upload slides to configured image host (Imgur/R2/S3/local server)
4. Post to Instagram via Graph API

The script is at /root/.hermes/scripts/cron_carousel.py
